name: watch2learn
description: Local-first vocabulary learning from permitted video content

scripts.setup: uv sync --group asr && bash scripts/bootstrap-media-tools.sh && pnpm setup:asr && pnpm setup:dictionary && pnpm setup:translation
scripts.dev: uv run --group asr uvicorn watch2learn.app:app --app-dir apps/api --reload --port 8000
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check apps/api scripts/bootstrap-asr-model.py scripts/bootstrap-dictionary.py scripts/bootstrap-translation-model.py
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check apps/api scripts/bootstrap-asr-model.py scripts/bootstrap-dictionary.py scripts/bootstrap-translation-model.py
scripts.quality: pnpm whitespace && pnpm policy:free && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && bash scripts/doctor.sh --ci
